segments.name: Frozen Food Products
segments.description: Manufacturing and distributing frozen food products to food service and retail customers throughout the United States.
segments.evidence: Bridgford currently operates in two business segments - the processing and distribution of frozen food products and the processing and distribution of snack food products.

segments.name: Snack Food Products
segments.description: Manufacturing and distributing non-refrigerated snack food products through direct-store-delivery and warehouse distribution networks.
segments.evidence: Bridgford currently operates in two business segments - the processing and distribution of frozen food products and the processing and distribution of snack food products.

revenueModel.text: Customers purchase frozen and snack food products through food service distributors, retail distributors, and direct-store-delivery to retail locations.
revenueModel.evidence: Products produced by the Frozen Food Products segment are generally supplied to food service and retail distributors who take title to the product upon shipment receipt.
